subject: Post-demo: decision path + evidence runbook for BlueAnchor pilot
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Michael Turner <mturner@blueanchor.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: decision path + evidence runbook for BlueAnchor pilot

Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciated the candid feedback and the clarity on your top priorities. Quick recap and proposed runbook so we can align internal owners and hit BlueAnchor's procurement windows.

Key decisions from the call
- Goal: 6-week pilot focused on low-latency financial data enrichments.
- Must-haves: SOC 2 Type II evidence, pen test summary, audit logs access, and a clear data retention policy for PII.
- Timeline target (from BlueAnchor): procurement signature + infra readiness within 3 weeks of evidence delivery.

Stakeholders (as understood)
- Economic buyer: Sarah Cho (CFO) — final sign-off on spend and contract terms.
- Security lead: Raj Patel — technical validation, pen test/SSO/VPC questions.
- Procurement / Legal: Michael Turner — day-to-day coordination and contract routing.

Proposed evidence runbook (what we'll deliver + owner + ETA)
1) SOC 2 Type II package (report + bridge letter + controls matrix) — Owner: Rishi Malhotra — ETA: 48 hours
2) Pen test summary + scope doc (we will provide our latest report and an approved vendor list) — Owner: Rishi (coordinate with infra) — ETA: 3 business days
3) Audit logs sample & retention answers (S3 export, retention windows) — Owner: Laura Bennett — ETA: 2 business days
4) Data handling & retention FAQ (PII handling, retention, deletion hooks) — Owner: Soojin Lee — ETA: 2 business days
5) Procurement-friendly MSA + MS Word redline-ready file (DocuSign preview link to follow) — Owner: Soojin/Legal — ETA: EOD next Monday

Attachments I'm preparing for you: SOC2-report-2026.pdf (summary), pen-test-scope.docx, redwood-evidence-checklist.xlsx. If you prefer zipped folder or a secure Drive share, tell me and we'll send that instead.

Two asks for you to unblock timelines
- Can you confirm the economic buyer's email for routing commercial terms (is Sarah at sarah.cho@blueanchor.com?)
- Please share the procurement/legal contact for DocuSign routing if different from Michael.

Next steps
- I'll push the SOC 2 package to the Drive link and ping Rishi to open the pen-test sync.
- Proposed follow-up: 30-minute call next Tuesday to confirm receipt and any follow-up technical questions.

Thanks and speak soon,

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187
[attachment: redwood-evidence-checklist.xlsx (excel, 42KB)]

From: Michael Turner <mturner@blueanchor.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@blueanchor.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: decision path + evidence runbook for BlueAnchor pilot

Thanks, Soojin — this is helpful and the timeline looks promising. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed economic buyer: Sarah Cho (CFO) — email is sarah.cho@blueanchor.com (cc'd). She will sign off on the pilot spend but expects legal to review the MSA.
- Security contact: Raj Patel (cc'd separately on this thread) is our security manager and will be the primary technical reviewer for SOC2/pen test items.
- Procurement process: we require SOC 2 report + evidence folder before we engage procurement for PO/commit. If evidence is delivered early next week, we can aim to complete legal review by the following week.

Couple of quick technical asks Raj will likely raise (so you can prepare answers):
1) Do you provide SSO via SAML + IdP metadata?
2) Can you support VPC peering or PrivateLink for the pilot?
3) What is token/key rotation cadence and where are keys stored?

Also — can you provide a short bullet summary we can share with legal (one page) that lists: scope of data processed, retention windows, subprocessors, and redaction policies? That helps speed procurement.

If you can get the SOC2 package before EOD Monday, we can accelerate. Thanks again.

— Michael
Procurement Manager | BlueAnchor Financial
mturner@blueanchor.com | +1 212-555-0144

On Wed, 25 Nov 2026 at 14:10 Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciated the candid feedback and the clarity on your top priorities. Quick recap and proposed runbook so we can align internal owners and hit BlueAnchor's procurement windows.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: BlueAnchor evidence delivery plan

All — copying the thread and proposing concrete owners/timestamps so we don't miss the procurement window.

Confirmed owner tasks
- SOC2 pack (report + controls matrix + bridge letter): I'll assemble the trimmed package for vendor consumption. ETA: Monday 30 Nov 12:00 PT.
- Pen test summary + approved vendor list: I'll attach our last pen test summary and a recommended vendor list. I'll include the pen-test-scope.docx for clarity. ETA: Wednesday 2 Dec (we can accelerate parts if BlueAnchor needs faster evidence).
- Audit logs sample / retention answers (S3 export + retention table): Laura to deliver by Monday 30 Nov 17:00 PT.
- One-page legal summary for procurement: Soojin to draft; I'll help with subprocessors list.

Delivery method
- I'll upload the SOC2 package to the shared Drive folder and create a secure link to send to Michael/Sarah.
- For sensitive docs, we'll use restricted Drive share and DocuSign for any required signatures.

Risks & blockers
- If Raj requests a live pen test report with raw findings, we will need an NDA amendment; recommend pushing our summary + remediation evidence first.
- VPC peering/PrivateLink may require infra lead sign-off; flagging as potential delay.

I'll post the Drive link as soon as the SOC2 package is ready.

Thanks — Rishi
Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
[rishi_malhotra@redwood.com]

Next steps
- We'll send DocuSign preview for the MSA later today. If you can review and indicate redline items, we'll have Legal prioritize.
- Proposed alignment call: Wednesday 1 Dec, 10:00 AM ET — 30 min to go over any outstanding technical questions.

Thanks all — attaching the checklist again for your reference.
